cancel.scope: Conservative K099 involution cancellation and commutation; exact phase-aware table

affine.scope: X/CX/SWAP GF(2) matrix resynthesis; no ancilla assumptions

factor.scope: Shared-control same-target CCX XOR factoring with exact proof

mitm.scope: Bidirectional exact permutation synthesis, <=3 wires; capped states and depth

stochastic.scope: Random exact rewrite walk and neutral commuting moves; not annealing

smt.scope: Z3 bit-parallel exact synthesis <=4 wires, <=16 output slots; independent exhaustive proof

ROM_QRR.scope: K168 Q14 ROM copied unchanged and reproduced; 240 CCX, 4 clean scratch, 25 standalone wires

Clifford_simplification.scope: Supported self-inverse diagonal/reversible gates only; no general H/S tableau synthesis

CCX_CCZ_decomposition.scope: Different decompositions must be priced by actual official executed metric

phase_polynomial.scope: Global phase tracked for an affine block, exact rank-four Walsh identity and independently proven nonlinear predicate folding.

ancilla_reuse_uncomputation.scope: Dirty-input exact proofs cannot justify introducing clean-ancilla assumptions

circuit_rescheduling.scope: Neutral local commutation inside exact walk; no global branch-aware scheduler

common_subexpression_elimination.scope: Shared-control CCX only; no general DAG CSE

arithmetic_resynthesis_adders_comparator.scope: Truth-table XOR oracles up to eight wires, two-bit in-place add/subtract, shared product/carry architectures.

register_recycling.scope: Elide dirty workspace compute/uncompute for a helper with fanout. Physical width reduction remains unsupported.

lookup_ROM_synthesis.scope: Preserved K168 oracle and opt-in QROM product reuse across guarded lookup writes and cleanup phases on KMX; no arbitrary table regeneration

piecewise_polynomial_Horner_precision.scope: Numerical successes in history do not establish competitive reversible resource cost

rotation_merging_quantization_redistribu.scope: Exact KMX 128-bit phase merge and exact Boolean predicate folding. Approximate quantization is unsupported.

Fourier_Walsh_Chebyshev_minimax_range_re.scope: Exact Walsh rank-four null relation only. Chebyshev, minimax and range reduction are unsupported.

error_budget_piecewise_phase.scope: Needs full-domain error evaluator and measured official synthesis costs

beam_best_first.scope: Existing legacy beam retained unchanged; new controller uses UCB over bounded jobs, not full candidate beam search

simulated_annealing_genetic.scope: No temperature schedule or evolutionary population

SAT_SMT.scope: Scoped quadratic parity-product SMT and legacy bounded gate SMT. Exact truth-table confirmation, separate solver results and function cache.

cost_aware_superoptimization.scope: Static CCX/T proxy with official-only promotion; no calibrated dynamic rotation predictor

identity_screen.scope: Dark Star-inspired complete identity subblock screening for supported bounded unitary blocks, including exact phase and dirty wires

parity_spectrum.scope: LWE-inspired affine Walsh character grouping for discrete single-wire phases, with exact mod-eight proof

affine_smt.scope: Single-target quadratic oracle and up to five inputs, GF(2) rank bound, unordered dictionary and bounded product-count iterative deepening.

general_modular_or_fixed_point.scope: No complete modular arithmetic or scale-aware fixed-point recognition and replacement.

noise_aware_optimization.scope: No measured hardware noise model in the optimization contract.

conditional_phase.scope: Common unchanged classical bit on contiguous KMX diagonals. Exact two-branch cancellation or shared CCZ-product factoring with preserved guard.
